allocation.output: Repair the eight existing refusal frame names with REF; retain IDs/pixels and rename no source master. Fresh approved call must guard exact current names first.

Use each assigned profile and stream minima, not a Cartesian product: standard and screen-reader for all four streams; reduced-motion S-HIGH; low-power S-LOW; forced-colours and print S-SEMANTIC; additional missing template modes once at their appropriate peer stream. Recovery baseline ERROR/320/FORCED-COLORS must be a full host in each of four streams. Build visual mode changes where needed, not renamed identical captures.

Use the complete profile gap list below. Critical states need distinct visual evidence; noncritical values may have truthful state/interaction annotations. Reuse existing recovery grammar only when visibly assembled with a named host, current stream and safe primary action; its 48 unscoped specimens alone earn no host/stream credit. Assess CLOSED navigation, directory STALE and 404/410 behavior explicitly.

VP-NARROW and VP-TABLET may link actual 320/landscape/desktop bounds only after checking identical structure and reading/action order. VP-WIDE needs measured line length/control placement. Existing 320, landscape, desktop and reflow frames stay the bounding sources; no new frame merely to raise a count.

Produce design PROTOTYPE and semantic specifications for disclosure open/close/invoker return, modal versus nonmodal search, clear/close/result actions, radio selection versus explicit Apply, preserved-context errors and expiry warning/extension. D078 controls: at least20 seconds warning, simple action, at least10 extension opportunities. Show each stream independently; no Figma animation is a native keyboard/screen-reader test.

After coverage and interaction review: deterministic PNG@2x/SVG exports and prototype flow sheets, reconciled evidence manifest, native archive/restore and EXIT, separate independent design/accessibility reviews, then founder pilot acceptance. Later TEST_CAPTURE remains after implementation, outside MA025.

limits: Names/receipt correlations are preparation evidence, not a complete exit manifest or qualitative coverage adjudication.
Missing encoded names do not establish that no inherited or separately recorded annotation exists; inspect those before authoring duplicate evidence.
Shared grammar labels carry no explicit stream or host; no implicit S-SEMANTIC assignment.
Eight refusal names omit REF in the executed input; confirmed live names require preflight. Existing scoped pixel reviews remain valid at their original inputs.
No full canvas read, physical editability census, font-rights approval, runtime behavior, accessibility conformance or complete-process proof.
